title: Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2610.01781v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). translated_title: 无最大终端成分（MEC）MDP中可达性问题的Q学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）对可达性规范的处理是序贯决策领域的基础问题。先前的工作已经建立了向最优策略的渐近收敛保证，但仅限于基于模型的方法，这类方法必须显式估计底层马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的转移概率。我们提出了Quasar，这是首个在无非终端最大终端成分（MEC）的MDP片段上具备渐近保证的无模型可达性算法——而该片段是一个基本构建模块，任何MDP都可通过标准的MEC商化简归结于此。我们的算法遵循经典的Q学习框架，使用时序差分更新即可收敛到最优策略，全程无需学习转移概率。由此得到的学习器将内存占用从基于模型方法所需的O(|S|²|A|)降低到O(|S||A|)。在标准化的定量验证基准测试集上，我们的算法收敛到最优（策略）……
tldr: 提出首个面向无MEC（最大终端成分）MDP可达性问题的无模型Q学习算法Quasar，无需估计转移概率即可渐近收敛到最优策略，并将内存占用从O(|S|²|A|)降至O(|S||A|)。
en_tdlr: Quasar, the first model-free Q-learning algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability in MEC-free MDPs, converges to optimal policies without learning transition probabilities while reducing memory footprint from O(|S|^2|A|) to O(|S||A|).
